May 17, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Andrew Weiss increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 196.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Weiss Asset Management Lp bought 7,537 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The hedge fund run by Andrew Weiss held 11,372 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.19M, up from 3,835 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Weiss Asset Management Lp who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $58.18B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.55% or $1.26 during the last trading session, reaching $80.1. About 3.49 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
